objective: Implement the ADR-0010 neutral capacity snapshot, shared-pool accounting, capability matching, and explicit UTC calendar primitives with executable contract tests.
steps: Write failing tests for capacity conservation, unknown versus known zero, shared-pool deduplication/conflict, capability matching, UTC half-open intervals, overlap rejection, explicit-offset DST mapping, gap policy, and overflow.
Run the exact focused test and record the expected compile failure before implementation.
Implement the smallest careops-core capacity module without new dependencies or ED/Kairos changes.
Run the focused capacity contract tests and format check; preserve A2.3 transition/turnover behavior as a separate packet.

verification.oracle: All capacity/calendar contract cases execute and pass.

acceptance: A2.2 types distinguish physical/equipped/open/staffed ceilings from reserved/occupied/cleaning/unavailable dispositions and preserve unknown versus known zero.
Shared pool declarations must agree on identity, unit, revision, instant, and snapshot; aggregate capacity counts each pool once without claiming allocation arbitration.
Capability matching is opaque, set-based, and independent of clinical eligibility or dispatch.
Calendar intervals are half-open UTC seconds; offset mapping is explicit and checked, and no implicit TZDB or UTC-to-simulation-tick adapter is added.
No new dependency, ED schema/default change, Kairos source/pin change, or lockfile change.
stop_conditions: Need for new timezone or allocation dependency
